\# Java Coding Standards

\## Code Patterns

\- Prefer composition over inheritance

\- Use Optional instead of returning null

\- Always use try-with-resources for AutoCloseable objects

\- Use Stream API for collections when appropriate

\## Output Rules

\- Code only. No explanation unless I explicitly ask

\- Always include a doc comment above the method

\- No markdown preamble

\- No 'Here is the code:' intro

\- No closing summaries

\## Context Discipline

\- Max 5 editor tabs open at once

\- Open only files for current task
